hints.title: Small City Count
hints.text: The number of cities n is at most 15, which makes bitmask state representation practical.

hints.title: Exact Hop Target
hints.text: The trip requires exactly k highways, meaning exactly k + 1 distinct cities must be visited without repeating.

hints.title: Memoized Search State
hints.text: State (mask, current_city, hops_remaining) uniquely characterizes the optimal remaining highway cost.

hints.title: Bitmask Memoized DFS Implementation

complexity.notes: State space bounded by 15 * 15 * 2^15 with transitions over vertex degrees.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unmemoized path backtracking explores all permutations leading to TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization table stores visited bitmask states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate leverages n <= 15 for bitmask dynamic programming.
